title: Ai Cooked and your upset?
author: Z1supercpu
selftext: This post is for anyone that is not able to understand what is currently happening with video games, and to reply to people who are upset that They cannot definitively break down terms that are used today. Because I have pointed out lazy people and people who literally just want to ship their games and post about how many wishlists they received, I get people who argue the idea of Ai slop. Unfortunately they don’t understand that it’s humans that push dominoes and people who iterate or correct Ai and still blame a computer for their lack of creativity, and the fact that undeveloped one shot prompt or games made from single text captures don’t come out well. Then the games are pushed by a person to the market or to harass you through ads. I really feel bad for people that can’t understand this and still show ignorance by terming it Ai slop, yes the computer made it but your missing the point that You want to blame a six year old for artwork when their parents sell it? Who is more responsible for putting out a bad product? Exactly. I removed my posts in the past so not influence the general public because the ignorance had led me to believe that they don’t deserve to have such knowledge and now, I find it deserving to claim intelligence so that the ones lacking can understand how they are wrong. Also for those that use consistent thinking will agree on this thought. So I figure there will always be people that want to speak to cover their faults and that is what this argument is, don’t tell me how many wishlists you have, or that Ai slop is ruining games, because it’s not, it’s actually a bridge to people that didn’t have the ability to goto school and learn code to make things they can now, and if you went to school, great then where are your games your so proud of? Don’t send me a screen shot of 2d games that have no curb appeal.
